title: bind exact operator approval to AgentCore PlanSpec and SecurityExecutionEngine effect envelope

files.role: exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, and SecurityExecutionEngine binding projection script

criteria: The projection script consumes RC10-020 target enrollment evidence and upstream publication, drift-zero, and installer fetch evidence before evaluating execution binding.
The exact approval artifact records exact-approval-denied with missing approval id, actor, authority scope, target node ids, expiry, nonce, and audit sink.
The AgentCore PlanSpec artifact records a deterministic PlanSpec core hash while remaining non-executable because approval and SecurityExecutionEngine binding are missing.
The SecurityExecutionEngine artifact denies the controlled-canary-activation effect and keeps activation, rollback, support upload, production ring mutation, and remote dispatch disabled.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and moves the next task to RC10-022 controlled canary activation.
